title: Programming in Python
standfirst: Python from first principles — data types, control flow, functions, files, and the standard library.

description_paragraphs: This course serves as the first formal introduction to programming in the programme. It introduces Python - used throughout the curriculum - while developing foundational problem-solving and algorithmic skills.
faculty: Prof. Sudarshan Iyengar, Department of Computer Science and Engineering, IIT Ropar

weeks_text.label: Week 1
weeks_text.text: Programming basics - Replit, variables, data types, operators, strings; Common errors.

weeks_text.label: Week 2
weeks_text.text: Variables and dynamic typing; Operators and expressions; Strings (methods, escape characters, applications); Conditional statements (if, else, elif); Importing libraries.

weeks_text.label: Week 3
weeks_text.text: Iteration - while, for, nested loops; Range; Loop control (break, continue, pass); Formatted output; Applications.

weeks_text.label: Week 4
weeks_text.text: Lists, sets and tuples; List comprehensions; Introduction to functions; Function types and arguments.

weeks_text.label: Week 5
weeks_text.text: Dictionaries; Functions and scope; Iterators and generators; Functional tools; Applications (sorting, matrix multiplication).

weeks_text.label: Week 8
weeks_text.text: File handling - reading and writing; Handling large files; Applications (Caesar cipher, genetic sequences).

weeks_text.label: Week 9
weeks_text.text: Recursion - concepts and applications; Recursive problem solving (searching, sorting); Binary search (iterative and recursive).

weeks_text.label: Week 10
weeks_text.text: Exception handling; Introduction to object oriented programming; Classes and objects; Attributes and methods; Inheritance and method overriding.

weeks_text.label: Week 11
weeks_text.text: Numerical and data libraries - NumPy, Pandas (Series, DataFrames); Data visualization with Matplotlib.
